title: Gaussian integral over a half-line
statement:
For every function $f:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ and every $t\in\mathbb R$, its integral over $(-\infty,t]$ with respect to the standard Gaussian measure equals its Lebesgue integral over that interval weighted by the standard Gaussian density $\varphi$:
\[\int_{(-\infty,t]} f\,d\gamma=\int_{(-\infty,t]}\varphi(x)f(x)\,dx.\]
